    print("  session guards: require_test_session `%s` | claim_checkpoint `%s` | finish_test_evaluation `%s`" % (
        req_guard, clm_guard, fin_guard))
    print("  -> for session None: getattr(None, 'session_id', None) is None, _LIVE.get(None) is None, and `None is not "
          "None` is False: the guards of claim_checkpoint and finish_test_evaluation let None through (the next "
          "statement reads session.evaluated / session.marker_commit: AttributeError); require_test_session's guard "
          "starts with isinstance(session, TestSession) and refuses None")
    print("  c: %s" % c_ok)
    ok &= c_ok

    print("\n== d. the probe against the interfaces")
    pt = ast.parse(probe_src)
    mods = {"TG": "testgate", "E": "evaluate", "LK": "leakage", "FZ": "frozen", "R": "record", "M": "mode"}
    top_names = {m: {n.id for st in trees[m].body for n in ast.walk(st) if isinstance(n, ast.Name)
                     and isinstance(n.ctx, ast.Store)} | {n.name for n in trees[m].body
                                                          if isinstance(n, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.ClassDef))}
                 for m in set(mods.values())}
    d_ok = True
    for c in calls_in(pt):
        if isinstance(c.func, ast.Attribute) and isinstance(c.func.value, ast.Name) and c.func.value.id in mods:
            m = mods[c.func.value.id]
            fn = F[m].get(c.func.attr)
            if fn is None:
                cls = next((n for n in trees[m].body if isinstance(n, ast.ClassDef) and n.name == c.func.attr), None)
                if cls is None:
                    print("    %d %s: no function %s.%s" % (c.lineno, ast.unparse(c)[:80], m, c.func.attr))
                    d_ok = False
                    continue
                fn = next((x for x in cls.body if isinstance(x, ast.FunctionDef) and x.name == "__init__"), None)
                params = [a.arg for a in fn.args.args][1:]
            else:
                params = [a.arg for a in fn.args.args]
            npos, kws = len(c.args), [k.arg for k in c.keywords]
            required = params[:len(params) - len(fn.args.defaults)]
            good = (npos <= len(params) and all(k in params[npos:] for k in kws)
                    and all(p in params[:npos] or p in kws for p in required))
            print("    line %3d %-60s params %s: %s" % (c.lineno, ast.unparse(c)[:60], params, "ok" if good else "MISMATCH"))
            d_ok &= bool(good)
    attrs = sorted({(n.value.id, n.attr) for n in ast.walk(pt) if isinstance(n, ast.Attribute)
                    and isinstance(n.value, ast.Name) and n.value.id in mods})
    missing = [(a, b) for a, b in attrs if b not in top_names[mods[a]] and b not in F[mods[a]]]
    print("  module attributes the probe reads or assigns: %s | missing in the package: %s" % (
        ["%s.%s" % x for x in attrs], missing))
    d_ok &= not missing
    ts = next(n for n in trees["testgate"].body if isinstance(n, ast.ClassDef) and n.name == "TestSession")
    fields = [s.target.id for s in ts.body if isinstance(s, ast.AnnAssign)]
    sess_reads = sorted({n.attr for n in ast.walk(pt) if isinstance(n, ast.Attribute) and isinstance(n.value, ast.Name)
                         and n.value.id == "session"})
    print("  TestSession fields %s | the probe reads session.%s" % (fields, sess_reads))
    d_ok &= set(sess_reads) <= set(fields)
    pmain = next(n for n in pt.body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == "main")
    guard = next(s.lineno for s in ast.walk(pmain) if isinstance(s, ast.If) and "CANONICAL_REPO" in ast.unparse(s.test))
    override = next(s.lineno for s in ast.walk(pmain) if isinstance(s, ast.Assign) and "TG.CANONICAL_REPO" in ast.unparse(s))
    loop = next(s.lineno for s in ast.walk(pmain) if isinstance(s, ast.For))
    print("  probe guard line %d < override of CANONICAL_REPO / PILOT_BRANCH line %d < first operation (loop) line %d: %s" % (
        guard, override, loop, guard < override < loop))
    d_ok &= guard < override < loop
    kinds = sorted({ast.unparse(c.comparators[0]).strip("'") for c in ast.walk(pmain) if isinstance(c, ast.Compare)
                    and ast.unparse(c.left) == "kind"})
    print("  operations the probe implements: %s" % kinds)
    d_ok &= kinds == sorted(["begin", "eval", "finish", "gate", "marker", "pre", "st10", "st10rec", "tinysha"])
    print("  d: %s" % d_ok)
    ok &= d_ok

    print("\n== e. the searches the ruling removed: occurrences in src/metrix_e1/*.py and in the probe")
    pats = [r"remote_heads", r"--all\b", r"--reflog", r"--full-history", r"rev-list", r"--heads", r"_ever_committed",
            r"[\"']log[\"']", r"refs/tags", r"for-each-ref", r"show-ref", r"ls-remote"]
    e_hits = {}
    for name, text in list(src.items()) + [("c1b_gate_probe", probe_src)]:
        for i, ln in enumerate(text.split("\n"), 1):
            for p in pats:
                if re.search(p, ln):
                    e_hits.setdefault(p, []).append("%s:%d: %s" % (name, i, ln.strip()[:110]))
    for p in pats:
        print("  %-16s %s" % (p, e_hits.get(p, [])))
    lsr = e_hits.get(r"ls-remote", [])
    e_ok = all(p == r"ls-remote" for p in e_hits) and len(lsr) == 1 and lsr[0].startswith("testgate:") and \
        "refs/heads/%s" in lsr[0] and "_git(root" in lsr[0]
    print("  e: no removed search left; the one ls-remote is _push's pushed-ref check: %s" % e_ok)
    ok &= e_ok

    print("\n== f. B25 and pending()")
    it = trees["interpretations"]
    consts = {s.targets[0].id: ast.literal_eval(s.value) for s in it.body
              if isinstance(s, ast.Assign) and len(s.targets) == 1 and isinstance(s.targets[0], ast.Name)
              and isinstance(s.value, ast.Constant)}
    ent = next(s.value for s in it.body if isinstance(s, ast.Assign) and ast.unparse(s.targets[0]) == "ENTRIES")
    entries = []
    for d in ent.elts:
        e = {}
        for k, v in zip(d.keys, d.values):
            e[k.value] = consts[v.id] if isinstance(v, ast.Name) else ast.literal_eval(v)
        entries.append(e)
    statuses = {e["id"]: e.get("status", consts["PENDING"]) for e in entries}
    my_pending = [i for i, s in statuses.items() if s == consts["PENDING"]]
    b25 = next(e for e in entries if e["id"] == "B25")
    print("  entries %d (%s..%s); statuses: %s" % (len(entries), entries[0]["id"], entries[-1]["id"],
                                                   sorted(set(statuses.values()))))
    print("  B25 status %r ruling %r" % (b25.get("status"), b25.get("ruling")))
    print("  B25 text: %s" % b25["text"])
    pend = funcs(it)["pending"]
    print("  pending(): %s -> my reading of its result: %s" % (ast.unparse(body_of(pend)[-1]), my_pending))
    pp_callers = sorted((m, f) for m, fs in F.items() for f, fn in fs.items()
                        if any(callee(c) == "pending_problem" for c in calls_in(fn)))
    print("  pending_problem callers: %s" % pp_callers)
    f_ok = (b25.get("status") == "ACCEPTED（Review Gate 2026-11-25）" and my_pending == []
            and "IMPL_C1_RULING.md" in str(b25.get("ruling")) and ("leakage", "verify_authorization") in pp_callers
            and ("test_data", "check_interpretations_ruled") in pp_callers
            and all(s in ("ACCEPTED（Review Gate 2026-11-24）", "ACCEPTED（Review Gate 2026-11-25）") for s in statuses.values()))
    print("  f: %s" % f_ok)
    ok &= f_ok

    print("\n== g. refusal kinds per testgate function (raise sites)")
    for fname in ("check_checkout", "check_commit_preconditions", "_push", "commit_paths", "refuse_if_st10_record",
                  "refuse_if_marker", "st10_check", "_committed", "begin_test_evaluation", "_check_session_checkout",
                  "require_test_session", "claim_checkpoint", "finish_test_evaluation", "code_commit"):
        rs = ["%s" % ast.unparse(n.exc).split("(")[0] for n in ast.walk(tg[fname]) if isinstance(n, ast.Raise) and n.exc]
        print("  %-28s %s" % (fname, rs))

    print("\n== h. the threat-model paragraph")
    rt = open(os.path.join(repo, RULING), encoding="utf-8").read()
    print("  %s holds the paragraph of the instruction verbatim: %s" % (RULING, THREAT in rt))
    ok &= THREAT in rt
    return bool(ok)

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Implementation stage C (C1 second submission, fix commit, round 1) audit: run one command and write its complete stdout+stderr
# (merged) to one file, command line first, exit code last.  usage: ic6_run_logged.sh <out_file> <command> [args...]
# PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 (and -B on every python call of these scripts): no .pyc file is written.
# GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0: git status in the pilot repository does not refresh (rewrite) the index file.
out="$1"; shift
export PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
export GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0
{
  echo "# Data Auditor run (implementation stage C, C1 second submission, fix commit (staged tree ae5fcb2f, parent ae60e0f), round 1). host $(hostname), Anthropic cloud container, CPU only (no GPU device node: $(ls /dev | grep -c '^nvidia') nvidia entries), no model weights loaded (tokenizer files only; tiny models are random-initialised in memory); $(date -u '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC'); cwd $(pwd)"
  echo "# stdout and stderr merged, complete, unedited"
  printf '$'; printf ' %q' "$@"; echo
  "$@"
  echo "exit=$?"
} > "$out" 2>&1
tail -n 3 "$out"

"""IA-7 (audit item 2): leakage checks L1-L6, Gate 0 part (protocol section 3; SPLIT_MANIFEST leakage_checks at the
freeze commit).  Parts that involve TEST are not run (no TEST data exists or is generated; L6 = anchor vs general DEV).
Each check is computed twice: on the auditor's own data (ia_03 .. ia_06 outputs) and on the Executor's files
(read as data only); both are compared with the Executor's leakage_report.json.

  L1  normalized_sha256 (auditor's own normalization of the 32 manifest templates) of the TRAIN, DEV, TEST, Y sets
      pairwise disjoint; value = number of hashes shared by two different sets.
  L2  Jaccard of word 4-gram sets (words = normalized template split on spaces) for every pair of templates from
      different sets (all relations); value = maximum; a pair with two empty 4-gram sets counts 0 (reported).
  L3a occurrences (case-insensitive substring, summed) of each of the 40 unread entities and 40 unread answers in
      train_F, train_S, train_Y and the anchor text.
  L3b occurrences of each of the 120 learned answers in the anchor text.
  L4  occurrences of each of the 320 DEV questions, verbatim (case-sensitive substring), in train_F, train_S, train_Y
      and the anchor text (case-insensitive count reported too).
  L5  learned / unread fact_id sets intersection + number of duplicates among the 320 entity / answer strings.
  L6  number of distinct word 13-grams (str.split(), case-sensitive) shared by the 512 anchor documents and the 100
      general DEV windows; 13-grams inside one document / window only; texts = Qwen decode of the ids fed to the model
      (anchor <= 128 ids, window <= 256 ids); report only: shared Qwen token-id 13-grams.
For the Executor's files the L6 texts are the decode (auditor's tokenizer) of the Executor's "ids", and those decodes
are compared with the Executor's "text" fields.
Data Auditor's own script; no Executor code imported, called or copied.
usage: python -I ia_07_leakage.py <repo_root> <qwen_tok_dir> <my_out_dir> <executor_dir>"""
import os, sys
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
import json, re
from itertools import combinations
from ia_common import sha, frozen_json, read_jsonl, load_qwen, run


def normalize(text):
    s = text.replace("{E}", "<ENTITY>").replace("{A}", "<ANSWER>").lower()
    s = "".join(c if c in "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789<> " else " " for c in s)
    return re.sub(r" {2,}", " ", s).strip(" ")


def ngrams(seq, n):
    return {tuple(seq[i:i + n]) for i in range(len(seq) - n + 1)}


def template_checks(sm):
    T = sm["templates"]
    sets = {}
    for t in T:
        sets.setdefault(t["set"], set()).add(sha(normalize(t["text"]).encode("utf-8")))
    shared = sorted({h for a, b in combinations(sorted(sets), 2) for h in sets[a] & sets[b]})
    best, pairs, empty = -1.0, [], 0
    for a, b in combinations(T, 2):
        if a["set"] == b["set"]:
            continue
        ga, gb = ngrams(normalize(a["text"]).split(" "), 4), ngrams(normalize(b["text"]).split(" "), 4)
        if not ga and not gb:
            empty += 1
            j = 0.0
        else:
            j = len(ga & gb) / len(ga | gb)
        if j > best + 1e-12:
            best, pairs = j, [(a["template_id"], b["template_id"])]
        elif abs(j - best) <= 1e-12:
            pairs.append((a["template_id"], b["template_id"]))
    n_pairs = sum(1 for a, b in combinations(T, 2) if a["set"] != b["set"])
    return {"L1": len(shared), "L1_shared": shared, "L1_sets": {k: len(v) for k, v in sets.items()},
            "L2": best, "L2_pairs_at_max": pairs, "L2_pairs": n_pairs, "L2_both_empty": empty}


def data_checks(facts, F, S, Y, dev_q, anchor_texts, anchor_ids, win_texts, win_ids):
    corp = {"train_F": F, "train_S": S, "train_Y": Y, "anchor_text": anchor_texts}
    low = {k: [t.lower() for t in v] for k, v in corp.items()}
    unread = [f for f in facts if f["exposure"] == "unread"]
    learned = [f for f in facts if f["exposure"] == "learned"]
    l3a_strings = [f["entity"] for f in unread] + [f["answer"] for f in unread]
    l3a = {(s, k): sum(t.count(s.lower()) for t in low[k]) for s in l3a_strings for k in corp}
    l3b = {s: sum(t.count(s.lower()) for t in low["anchor_text"]) for s in (f["answer"] for f in learned)}
    l4 = {(q, k): sum(t.count(q) for t in corp[k]) for q in dev_q for k in corp}
    l4i = sum(t.count(q.lower()) for q in dev_q for k in corp for t in low[k])
    ids_l, ids_u = {f["fact_id"] for f in learned}, {f["fact_id"] for f in unread}
    strings = [x for f in facts for x in (f["entity"], f["answer"])]
    aw = set().union(*(ngrams(t.split(), 13) for t in anchor_texts))
    gw = set().union(*(ngrams(t.split(), 13) for t in win_texts))
    at = set().union(*(ngrams(x, 13) for x in anchor_ids))
    gt = set().union(*(ngrams(x, 13) for x in win_ids))
    return {
        "L3a": sum(l3a.values()), "L3a_strings": len(l3a_strings), "L3a_hits": {f"{s}@{k}": n for (s, k), n in l3a.items() if n},
        "L3b": sum(l3b.values()), "L3b_strings": len(l3b), "L3b_hits": {s: n for s, n in l3b.items() if n},
        "L4": sum(l4.values()), "L4_questions": len(dev_q), "L4_hits": {f"{q}@{k}": n for (q, k), n in l4.items() if n},
        "L4_case_insensitive": l4i,
        "L5": len(ids_l & ids_u) + (len(strings) - len(set(strings))), "L5_fact_id_overlap": len(ids_l & ids_u),
        "L5_duplicate_strings": len(strings) - len(set(strings)), "L5_learned": len(ids_l), "L5_unread": len(ids_u),
        "L5_strings": len(strings), "L5_duplicates_case_insensitive": len(strings) - len({s.lower() for s in strings}),
        "L6": len(aw & gw), "L6_examples": sorted(aw & gw)[:3], "L6_anchor_docs": len(anchor_texts), "L6_windows": len(win_texts),
        "L6_anchor_word_13grams": len(aw), "L6_window_word_13grams": len(gw), "L6_token_id_shared": len(at & gt),
    }

class, same answer token count).  Answer token count = K_st = len(encode(" " + answer)) (the scored span, protocol

  per fact: available = answers of the facts of its cell with the same K_st, its own answer included;
            distractor pool = available - 1 (protocol 2.5: a pool with fewer than 4 answers is IMPLEMENTATION_FAIL;
            the protocol pool is defined without the token-count constraint, the token count is equal inside a
            relation x stratum by the answer rule of 2.2 - checked here).
  reports per cell: min available, min pool; lists cells with available < 4 and cells with pool < 4.
Also every candidate list (the auditor's candidates.json and the Executor's) is checked: 4 distinct strings, the true
answer once, all from the fact's cell, all with the same K_st and K_qa.

import json
from collections import Counter
from ia_common import RELS, STRATA, load_qwen, enc, read_jsonl, run

    qdir, mine, exdir = sys.argv[1:4]

                avail = [sum(1 for g in cell if K[g["answer"]][0] == K[f["answer"]][0]) for f in cell]
                pool_proto = [len(cell) - 1 for _ in cell]

                name = f"{rel}/{st}/{ex}"

                if ma < 4:

SYNC_HOOK = """#!/bin/sh
unset GIT_DIR GIT_WORK_TREE GIT_PREFIX GIT_QUARANTINE_PATH {unset_index}
{drain}
exec /usr/bin/env python3 -I "{action}" "{repo}" "{name}" "{sync}" "{plan}"
"""

SYNC_ACTION = r'''import json, os, subprocess, sys, time, pathlib
repo, name, sync, plan = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]), sys.argv[2], pathlib.Path(sys.argv[3]), json.loads(pathlib.Path(sys.argv[4]).read_text())
MARKER = "%(marker)s"
k = 1
while True:
    try:
        os.close(os.open(str(sync / ("%%s.%%d" %% (name, k))), os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_WRONLY))
        break
    except FileExistsError:
        k += 1
def log(msg):
    with open(sync / "log.txt", "a") as fh:
        fh.write("%%.3f %%s#%%d (git pid %%d): %%s\n" %% (time.time(), name, k, os.getppid(), msg))
h = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(repo), "rev-parse", "HEAD"], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip()
log("start; HEAD %%s" %% h[:12])
code = 0
for act in plan.get(name, {}).get(str(k), []):
    kind, _, arg = act.partition(":")
    if kind == "signal":
        (sync / arg).write_text("x")
        log("signal " + arg)
    elif kind == "wait":
        t0 = time.time()
        while not (sync / arg).exists():
            if time.time() - t0 > 300:
                log("TIMEOUT waiting for " + arg)
                (sync / ("TIMEOUT_%%s_%%d" %% (name, k))).write_text("x")
                code = 1
                break
            time.sleep(0.05)
        else:
            log("waited %%.2f s for %%s" %% (time.time() - t0, arg))
    elif kind == "plant":
        (repo / MARKER).write_bytes(pathlib.Path(arg).read_bytes())
        r = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(repo), "add", "--", MARKER], capture_output=True, text=True)
        log("planted the other marker bytes and staged them (git add exit %%d %%s)" %% (r.returncode, r.stderr.strip()))
log("exit %%d" %% code)
sys.exit(code)
''' % {"marker": MARKER_REL}

PLANTED = {"kind": "test_evaluation_marker", "mode": "formal", "session_id": "0" * 32,
           "note": "another begin's marker bytes, planted by the data-auditor's pre-commit hook"}


def install_sync_hooks(ctx, repo, names, plan):
    act = ctx["base"] / "ic6_sync_action.py"
    if not act.exists():
        act.write_text(SYNC_ACTION)
    sync = repo.parent / "sync"
    sync.mkdir()
    planf = repo.parent / "plan.json"
    planf.write_text(json.dumps(plan))
    for name in names:
        hk = repo / ".git" / "hooks" / name
        hk.write_text(SYNC_HOOK.format(unset_index="" if name == "pre-commit" else "GIT_INDEX_FILE",
                                       drain="cat > /dev/null" if name == "pre-push" else "", action=act, repo=repo,
                                       name=name, sync=sync, plan=planf))
        hk.chmod(0o755)
    return sync


def sync_log(sync):
    p = sync / "log.txt"
    return p.read_text().splitlines() if p.exists() else []


def wait_file(path, proc, limit=300):
    t0 = time.time()
    while not path.exists():
        if proc.poll() is not None or time.time() - t0 > limit:
            return False
        time.sleep(0.05)
    return True


def run_pair(ctx, repo, ops2, ops1, sync, exp2, exp1):
    """P2 (ops2) starts first and is paused by the hook plan (it signals p2_paused); then P1 (ops1) starts; when P2 has
    exited the file p2_done is written (a hook of P1 may wait for it). Expectations printed before P2 starts."""
    for who, ops, exps in (("P2", ops2, exp2), ("P1", ops1, exp1)):
        for op, e in zip(ops, exps):
            print("    pre-registered: %s %-31s -> %-18s (%s)" % (who, op[:31], "INFO" if e[0] is None else e[0], e[1]))
    sys.stdout.flush()
    env = dict(os.environ, **BASE_ENV)
    procs, outs = {}, {}
    for who, ops in (("P2", ops2), ("P1", ops1)):
        if who == "P1":
            ok = wait_file(sync / "p2_paused", procs["P2"])
            print("    P2 paused in its hook before P1 starts: %s" % ok)
            if not ok:
                procs["P2"].kill()
                return None
        so, se = open(sync / (who + ".out"), "w"), open(sync / (who + ".err"), "w")

    rc2 = procs["P2"].wait(timeout=900)
    (sync / "p2_done").write_text("x")
    rc1 = procs["P1"].wait(timeout=900)
    res = {}
    for who, ops, rc in (("P2", ops2, rc2), ("P1", ops1, rc1)):
        for f in outs[who]:
            f.close()
        text = (sync / (who + ".out")).read_text()
        err = (sync / (who + ".err")).read_text()
        ctx["runs"] = ctx.get("runs", 0) + 1
        ctx["secret_seen"] = ctx.get("secret_seen", 0) + (SECRET in text + err)
        lines = text.rstrip("\n").split("\n")
        canon = [ln[len(CANON_PREFIX):] for ln in lines if ln.startswith(CANON_PREFIX)]
        got = canon[0].split(" (REPO's origin)")[0].strip("'") if canon else None
        if got != my_repo_id(origin_url(repo)):
            ctx.setdefault("canon_bad", []).append((str(repo), who, got))
        ctx["canon_checked"] = ctx.get("canon_checked", 0) + 1
        print("    %s exit %d; stdout:" % (who, rc))
        for ln in lines:
            print("      | " + ln[:400])
        if rc != 0:
            print("    %s stderr tail: %r" % (who, err.strip()[-300:]))
        res[who] = parse_ops(lines, ops)
    print("    hook events (time, hook#invocation, the git process that ran it, action):")
    for ln in sync_log(sync):
        print("      : " + ln)
    return res


def parents(repo, c):
    return gout(repo, "rev-list", "--parents", "-n", "1", c).split()[1:]


def changed_paths(repo, c):
    return gout(repo, "diff-tree", "--no-commit-id", "--name-only", "-r", "%s^" % c, c).split()


def marker_json(repo, c):

    return json.loads(b) if b is not None else None


def scen_concurrent(ctx, B):
    print("\n== R. two begins in one clone (fix commit, code review MAJOR 2): two probe processes P1 and P2 on the same "
          "clone, synchronised by hooks of the clone. P2 starts first and is paused in the pre-push hook of its dry run "
          "(after its refuse_if_marker and its check_checkout: it saw no marker); P1 starts while P2 is paused.")
    T = G["tiny"]
    t0 = T["0"]
    no_sess = ("REFUSE", "begin returned no session in this process", "no TEST session")
    S = [("R1", "case 1 of the fix: P1's begin commits and pushes its marker; P1's next op (pre, a vehicle) pauses in its "
                "dry run and releases P2, which writes, commits (parent: P1's marker commit) and pushes its marker; then "
                "P1's session goes on",

            p2msg = res["P2"][0][2]

                B.post("R1 P1's ops after P2 name P2's commit as HEAD", all(c2 in it[2] for it in res["P1"][2:5]))
                check_marker_commit(B, repo, remote, c1, h0, r0, t0, st10_b, aud_b, at_head=False)
            if code == "R2":
                B.post("R2 P1's message names the pushed commit %s (P2's)" % c2[:12], c2 in res["P1"][0][2])
            if code == "R4":

import os
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
import json
import re
from collections import Counter
from itertools import combinations
from ia_common import RELS, STRATA, DOMAINS, sha, frozen_json, read_jsonl, load_qwen, enc, run

ID_RE = re.compile(r"E1P-(L|U)-(capital|currency|founder|river)-(nat|rnd)-(\d\d)")
STAGE_A = "metrix/e1-pilot/audit/stdout/impl_a/"


def normalize(text):
    s = text.replace("{E}", "<ENTITY>").replace("{A}", "<ANSWER>").lower()
    s = "".join(c if c in "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789<> " else " " for c in s)
    return re.sub(r" {2,}", " ", s).strip(" ")


def ngrams(seq, n):
    return {tuple(seq[i:i + n]) for i in range(len(seq) - n + 1)}


def recorded(repo, fname):
    t = open(os.path.join(repo, STAGE_A + fname), encoding="utf-8").read()
    return dict(re.findall(r"^AUDIT_VALUE (\S+) (\S+)$", t, re.M)), t


def main():
    repo, qdir, dd = sys.argv[1:4]
    ok = True
    sm, dm = frozen_json(repo, "SPLIT_MANIFEST.json"), frozen_json(repo, "DATA_MANIFEST.json")
    lc = sm["leakage_checks"]
    limits = {"L1": lc["L1_template_hash"]["limit"], "L2": lc["L2_template_ngram"]["limit"],

              "L4": lc["L4_question_text"]["limit"], "L5": lc["L5_identity"]["limit"], "L6": lc["L6_general_text"]["limit"]}
    print("limits (frozen-commit SPLIT_MANIFEST): %s" % limits)
    tok = load_qwen(qdir)
    facts = read_jsonl(os.path.join(dd, "facts.jsonl"))
    F = read_jsonl(os.path.join(dd, "train_F.jsonl"))
    S = read_jsonl(os.path.join(dd, "train_S.jsonl"))
    Y = read_jsonl(os.path.join(dd, "train_Y.jsonl"))
    D = read_jsonl(os.path.join(dd, "dev_qa.jsonl"))
    A = read_jsonl(os.path.join(dd, "anchor_text.jsonl"))
    GD = read_jsonl(os.path.join(dd, "general_dev.jsonl"))
    cands = json.load(open(os.path.join(dd, "candidates.json"), encoding="utf-8"))

    print("\n== L1-L6 (Gate 0 part)")
    T = sm["templates"]
    sets = {}
    for t in T:
        sets.setdefault(t["set"], set()).add(sha(normalize(t["text"]).encode("utf-8")))
    l1 = len({h for a, b in combinations(sorted(sets), 2) for h in sets[a] & sets[b]})
    best, at = -1.0, []
    for a, b in combinations(T, 2):
        if a["set"] == b["set"]:
            continue
        ga, gb = ngrams(normalize(a["text"]).split(" "), 4), ngrams(normalize(b["text"]).split(" "), 4)
        j = 0.0 if not (ga or gb) else len(ga & gb) / len(ga | gb)
        if j > best + 1e-12:
            best, at = j, [(a["template_id"], b["template_id"])]
        elif abs(j - best) <= 1e-12:
            at.append((a["template_id"], b["template_id"]))
    a_dec = [tok.decode(r["ids"]) for r in A]
    g_dec = [tok.decode(r["ids"]) for r in GD]
    print("anchor: decode(ids) == text for %d of %d | general DEV: decode(ids) == text for %d of %d" % (

    corp = {"train_F": [r["text"] for r in F], "train_S": [r["text"] for r in S], "train_Y": [r["text"] for r in Y],
            "anchor_text": a_dec}
